These feasts have texts containing "N." but no ProperName set.
Add ProperName = <name> to the feast definition to replace "N." with the saint's name.
  vigil-st-james

  feast-id *                   (suppress all warnings for this feast)
  feast-id ref1 ref2 ...        (suppress specific refs only)
